title: Postprandial Gut Hormone Responses in Patients With Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus
brief_summary: The study will compare the postprandial responses to a test meal between subjects with type 1 diabetes and healthy control subjects, in terms of gut hormone levels, meal induced thermogenesis, hunger and satiety perception, as well as futher metabolic parameters.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 1 diabetes
* BMI \>30 kg/m2 for the obese groups

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diabetic neuropathy
* Malignancy
